fact: Zalthir headed to the northwest corner where there was a desk with some papers.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir knew he had enough to condemn the Derro and Duergar to a genocidal war that would result in the utter destruction of the city of Gracklstugh.
source_quote: Zalthir knows he has enough to condemn the Derro and Duergar to a genocidal war that will result in the utter destruction of the city of Gracklstugh.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir wondered, 'But is that the right thing to do?'
source_quote: “But is that the right thing to do?” he wonders.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum read what Zalthir had found and was disturbed.
source_quote: Grygum reads what Zalthir has found and is disturbed.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum remembered text from the temple about Bahamut.
source_quote: he remembers some text from the temple where he learned of the power of Bahamut - "When the egg, crimson-hued, promises but a shadow's ride, does one mend the shell, or seek to free the spark within? The true wyrm's form is not etched by fate's first breath, nor by sorcerous hand. It is the choices that twist the spirit, or set it soaring. To break the chains of another's dark design, even when madness fuels the crafting, is to affirm the very freedom Bahamut cherishes."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum scratched his head.
source_quote: He scratches his head.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum remembered how Bahamut’s clerics never gave him a straight answer.
source_quote: He remembers how Bahamut’s clerics never gave him a straight answer.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum declared, 'We shall return the egg to Gartokkar.'
source_quote: “We shall return the egg to Gartokkar,” he declares.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum stood at attention and turned to the rattling sound.
source_quote: Grygum stands at attention and turns to the rattling sound.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum approached Thorin and said, 'This is a baby dragon rattle. How curious.'
source_quote: Grygum approaches him, “This is a baby dragon rattle. How curious.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum examined the rattle and saw it said 'made by clan Thrazgad.'
source_quote: He examines it further, “It says made by clan Thrazgad.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum coughed.
source_quote: Grygum coughs.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum watched Thorin stare at him and realized what he said.
source_quote: Grygum watches as Thorin stares at him and realizes what he said

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum pulled out a scrap of paper and said, 'I’ve been taking notes on all of the deals we have made.'
source_quote: Grygum pulls out a scrap of paper, “I’ve been taking notes on all of the deals we have made.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum said, 'The best choice we have is to give the egg to Gartokkar and then use him to escape from Gracklstugh.'
source_quote: “I take notes. It’s what I do.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin shouted, 'Look what I found.'
source_quote: Thorin shouts, “Look what I found.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin rattled the baby rattle and said, 'We should get a baby dragon. I would like to have a dragon. It would be so cool if we had a dragon.'
source_quote: Thorin rattles it some more, “We should get a baby dragon. I would like to have a dragon. It would be so cool if we had a dragon.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin apologized for his words about pure dragons.
source_quote: I’m sorry. I didn’t mean that we don’t have a pure dragon, and that I wanted a pure dragon.” He pauses, “Okay, that sounded worse. I am going to stop now.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin sighed and said, 'Yeah.'
source_quote: Thorin sighs, “Yeah.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin stopped them and said, 'We need a name.'
source_quote: But Thorin stops them. “We need a name.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin said, 'I have it - The Ember Vanguard.'
source_quote: And then he smiles, “I have it - The Ember Vanguard.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin shouted, 'The Ember Vanguard are in the house!'
source_quote: Thorin shouts, “The Ember Vanguard are in the house!”

subject: Daz

source_quote: Daz shouts, “I have the egg.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'No.' when asked if they should attack the derro.

subject: Daz

subject: Diirdeklin the Derro

source_quote: And then he hears a booming voice - “The people you are trying to warn are dead.”

subject: Diirdeklin the Derro
fact: Diirdeklin dropped the alarm bell and grabbed his weapon more tightly.
source_quote: Diirdeklin’s hand drops the alarm bell and grabs his weapon more tightly.

subject: Diirdeklin the Derro
fact: Diirdeklin shouted, 'Yes, pass!'
source_quote: shouts, “Yes, pass!”

subject: Diirdeklin the Derro
fact: Diirdeklin thought, 'A Drow incursion! This is not good. And if they killed Pliinki, that means that they have bigger plans.'
source_quote: he thinks, “A Drow incursion! This is not good. And if they killed Pliinki, that means that they have bigger plans.”

subject: Diirdeklin the Derro
fact: Diirdeklin mutter, 'The Ember Vanguard - the Drow are now working with the Duergar to subdue us!'
source_quote: As they leave Diinarnnmyr mutters, “The Ember Vanguard - the Drow are now working with the Duergar to subdue us!”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum said, 'The egg is no longer a dragon. And so when this abomination hatches, the dragon Themberchaud will have its revenge on those who would think to control it.'
source_quote: “This is no longer a dragon. And so when this abomination hatches, the dragon Themberchaud will have its revenge on those who would think to control it.”

subject: Pliinki
fact: Pliinki believed the Obelisk was a magnificent, fractured thing hidden by Diirinka himself, and that its black metal hums with quasi-magical energy.
source_quote: The Obelisk. Such a magnificent, fractured thing! Hidden here by Diirinka himself, I am certain. Its black metal hums with quasi-magical energy, a power just waiting to be unleashed.

subject: Pliinki
fact: Pliinki believed the Thrazgad ore was discarded and forgotten next to her workbenches.
source_quote: It merely sits "discarded and forgotten" next to my workbenches.

subject: Pliinki
fact: Pliinki believed the egg was no mere insurance policy but the vessel for her greatest creation, a gift worthy of Demogorgon himself.
source_quote: This is no mere insurance policy; it is the vessel for my greatest creation, a gift worthy of Demogorgon himself.

subject: Pliinki
fact: Pliinki believed the Deepking would be delighted when he saw the egg, though he knew nothing of its true destiny.
source_quote: The Deep King will be "delighted" when he sees it, though he knows nothing yet of its true destiny.

subject: Pliinki
fact: Pliinki believed the two-headed wyrmling would serve as Demogorgon’s mount.
source_quote: a two-headed wyrmling, a perfect "Prince's gift" for Demogorgon, to serve as his mount.

subject: Pliinki
fact: Pliinki believed the Obelisk would be the instrument of ascension, allowing them to conquer Gracklstugh and deliver it as a sacrificial gift to Demogorgon.
source_quote: The Obelisk, once repaired, will be the instrument of our ascension, allowing us to conquer Gracklstugh and deliver it as a sacrificial gift to Demogorgon.

subject: Pliinki
fact: Pliinki believed the genocidal war against the derro would be the first cleansing.
source_quote: the "genocidal war" against the derro that Gartokkar so desires will merely be the first cleansing.

subject: Aliinka
fact: Aliinka confirmed the successful retrieval of both the dragon egg and the Clan Thrazgad ore.
source_quote: Uskvil confirmed the successful retrieval of both the dragon egg and the Clan Thrazgad ore, as ordered.

subject: Aliinka
fact: Aliinka believed the city spiraled precisely as planned, preparing for the true glory that awaited it.
